title: Model-aware kernel advisor for MHA/GQA/MoE based on activation sparsity & token density
creator: Sofia Becker
description: We need an automated advisor that selects and pins compilation/kernel profiles per model variant (MHA, GQA, MoE) using run-time indicators: activation sparsity, expert routing patterns, and token density. Goal is to reduce per-token latency variance and avoid regressions when moving models between hardware families. This ticket covers telemetry collection, advisor heuristic design, compiler integration hooks, and a safe rollout path for pinned profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Advisor proposes a ranked list of kernel profiles for a given model + sample workload with confidence scores
Telemetry pipeline provides per-model activation sparsity distribution and token-density histogram in Console
Runtime accepts a profile recommendation via an API and can apply it in a non-disruptive canary deployment
Rollout automation can fallback to previous profile on latency or correctness regression within 5 minutes
Documentation updated: onboarding checklist, advisor output format, and manual override instructions
implementation_plan: Instrument onboarding harness to emit activation sparsity, token-density, and routing entropy for MoE/GQA/MHA (lightweight counters + histograms)
Define profile feature vector (arch, sequence-length dist, avg activated experts, sparsity percentiles, token density) and storage schema in profile registry
Prototype advisor heuristics: rule-based cost model (latency/cost tradeoff) + fallback weight for numerical stability
Add compiler hook to accept advisor hints: preferred kernel family, quantization profile, group-size parameter, and jitter-safe apply mechanism
End-to-end e2e tests with small MoE toy model and GQA variant to validate latency and correctness across pinned profiles
Create canary rollout job in Dedicated and Hosted that uses advisor suggestions and monitors SLOs; implement automatic rollback policy
Add console dashboard cards for advisor recommendations, confidence, and recent rollouts
Write docs: onboarding checklist, how to interpret advisor output, emergency rollback steps
telemetry: token density histogram by sequence-length bucket
per-profile latency P50/P95/P99 under representative load
error/correctness deltas when applying a new profile
